## What
Create `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_agent_loader.py` with failing RED tests for the dispatch.py changes in task B.

## Tests (4 behavioral contracts)

### test_load_agent_prompt_raises_on_missing_file
```python
Given: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT set to a tmpdir with no agent files
When: _load_agent_prompt('code-reviewer-light') called
Then: raises RuntimeError (not returns _SYSTEM_PROMPT fallback)
```
FAILS pre-implementation: currently returns _SYSTEM_PROMPT instead of raising.

### test_plugin_root_prefers_claude_plugin_root_env
```python
Given: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT env var set to '/tmp/fake-plugin-root'
When: dispatch module _PLUGIN_ROOT is evaluated (or re-derived)
Then: _AGENTS_DIR resolves under '/tmp/fake-plugin-root/agents/', not __file__-relative path
```
FAILS pre-implementation: _PLUGIN_ROOT uses __file__-relative path only.

### test_validate_agent_files_raises_on_missing
```python
Given: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT points to tmpdir with only 5 of 10 agent files
When: _validate_agent_files(['code-reviewer-light', ..., 'code-reviewer-test-quality']) called
Then: raises RuntimeError listing all 5 missing file names
```
FAILS pre-implementation: _validate_agent_files does not exist.

### test_validate_agent_files_passes_when_all_present
```python
Given: all 10 agent .md files present in CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/
When: _validate_agent_files([...10 ids...]) called
Then: returns None (no exception)
```
FAILS pre-implementation: _validate_agent_files does not exist.

## Note on CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT isolation
Use monkeypatch.setenv('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT', str(tmp_path)) and reset _load_agent_prompt.cache_clear() before each test to avoid lru_cache interference.

## Files to Create
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_agent_loader.py (new file)

## Acceptance Criteria
- test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_agent_loader.py
- All 4 test functions fail pre-implementation (pytest returns non-zero)
- Tests use pytest monkeypatch for env var isolation
- Tests call _load_agent_prompt.cache_clear() before patching env

## Testing Mode
RED — all 4 tests fail pre-implementation
